full_text:
The NFL schedule started to trickle out in the weeks after the draft before the league revealed the entire 2026 schedule on May 14. Sportsbooks released their Week 1 opening lines and totals for games spanning Sept. 9-14, which kicks off with the __Seattle Seahawks__ hosting the __Dallas Cowboys__ in a matchup of last year’s Super Bowl participants. I recently released my updated [Post-Draft Power Rankings](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/), and I’ve included my line projection for every Week 1 contest.

The battle of former first overall picks between Baker Mayfield and the __Tampa Bay Buccaneers__ and Joe Burrow and the __Cincinnati Bengals__ is the only game with a total in the 50s on the board at 51.5 points. The __New York Jets__ and __Tennessee Titans__ are on the other end of the spectrum with the lowest total at 38.5 points, and the __Cleveland Browns__ and __Jacksonville Jaguars__ total is also south of 40 points. The __Los Angeles Chargers__ are the biggest favorites on the board as 9.5-point home favorites over the __Arizona Cardinals__. Three games are tied for the tightest spread at 1.5 points. It’s time to dive into these matchups to see if there are any lines that we should bet on now or if there are any lines we should hold off betting until closer to the start of the season.

\>Be sure to check out [Brolley’s Best Bets: 2026 NFL Futures](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/series/2025/best-bets) for my favorite futures bets all offseason…Subscribe to the Best Bets Podcast on your [favorite platform](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/podcasts/show/nfl-best-bets) and on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@FantasyPointsBetting) for year-round NFL betting talk…Join our “#official-bets” [Fantasy Points Discord](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/discord) to see our staff's wagers as soon as we make them!

__Week 1 Opening Lines__
------------------------

\>Lines courtesy of [FanDuel Sportsbook](https://pa.sportsbook.fanduel.com/navigation/nfl?tab=games) as of May 14.

 Matchup Time New England Patriots at Seattle Seahawks (-4.5, 45.5) 9/9 8:20 p.m. San Francisco 49ers vs. Los Angeles Rams (-2.5, 49.5), Australia 9/10 8:35 p.m. Chicago Bears (-2.5, 45.5) at Carolina Panthers 9/13 1 p.m. Cleveland Browns at Jacksonville Jaguars (-7.5, 39.5) 9/13 1 p.m. Atlanta Falcons at Pittsburgh Steelers (-2.5, 41.5) 9/13 1 p.m. New York Jets at Tennessee Titans (-2.5, 38.5) 9/13 1 p.m. Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cincinnati Bengals (-3.5, 51.5) 9/13 1 p.m. Baltimore Ravens (-3.5, 49.5) at Indianapolis Colts 9/13 1 p.m. New Orleans Saints at Detroit Lions (-7.5, 48.5) 9/13 1 p.m. Buffalo Bills (-1.5, 44.5) at Houston Texans 9/13 1 p.m. Miami Dolphins at Las Vegas Raiders (-3, 40.5) 9/13 4:05 p.m. Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Chargers (-9.5, 46.5) 9/13 4:05 p.m. Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles (-4.5, 47.5) 9/13 4:25 p.m. Green Bay Packers (-1.5, 46.5) at Minnesota Vikings 9/13 4:25 p.m. Dallas Cowboys (-2.5, 46.5) at New York Giants 9/13 8:20 p.m. Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs (-2.5, 43.5) 9/14 8:15 p.m. 

NFL Kickoff Game
----------------

#### __New England Patriots at Seattle Seahawks (-4.5, 45.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Seahawks -5

The NFL season kicks off with a rematch of the final game of the 2025 season. The Seahawks dominated the Patriots in a 29-13 victory as 4.5-point favorites to win the franchise’s second Lombardi Trophy. This matchup opened up in a similar spread range, even with the Seahawks receiving their Super Bowl rings in front of the “12s”. Seattle heads into the season with rookie __Jadarian Price__ taking over the backfield for Super Bowl MVP __Kenneth Walker__, who moved to the Chiefs in free agency. New England’s offseason has been filled with turmoil because of __Mike Vrabel__’s off-the-field transgressions.

Australia Game
--------------

#### __San Francisco 49ers vs. Los Angeles Rams (-2.5, 49.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Rams -2

The NFL heads to The Land Down Under for the first time. Aussies will get an entertaining introduction to tackle football with an important NFC West showdown. Los Angeles sits atop my Power Rankings after addressing its biggest need this offseason by adding Kansas City CBs __Trent McDuffie__ and __Jaylen Watson__. They’ll immediately be tested by San Francisco’s big offseason addition, __Mike Evans__, who left Tampa Bay for the first time to chase a second Super Bowl. The Rams and 49ers split two matchups outright and ATS last season, with both games finishing over the total. The winner will get a quick leg up in what should be an extremely competitive division — the top three NFC West teams combined for 38 wins last season. A win will also make the 15-hour flight back to California much more enjoyable.

Sunday
------

#### __Chicago Bears (-2.5, 45.5) at Carolina Panthers__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Bears -1

The Bears, Panthers, and their quarterbacks will forever be connected because of a blockbuster trade between the franchises in March 2023. The Panthers selected __Bryce Young__ first overall in 2023 with a pick acquired from the Bears. The Bears then selected __Caleb Young__ first overall a year later with a pick they acquired from the Panthers after Carolina finished with the NFL’s worst record in Young’s rough rookie season. Both teams started to turn a corner last season by reaching the postseason. The Panthers ended a seven-year playoff drought, and the Bears terminated a four-year postseason dry spell.

#### __Cleveland Browns at Jacksonville Jaguars (-7.5, 39.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Jaguars -5.5

The Jaguars completed an audacious trade-up with the Browns last spring to select __Travis Hunter__ at No. 2, who will be back in the lineup for the first time since his knee injury in late October. The Browns turned their extra picks into __Quinshon Judkins__, __Dylan Sampson__, and __KC Concepcion__, who will be key pieces in __Todd Monken__’s new offense. The big question is, will it be __Deshaun Watson__ or __Shedeur Sanders__ getting those offensive weapons the ball in the season opener? The Jaguars were awfully quiet in free agency coming off their fifth division championship in franchise history, and they were universally panned for their haul in the draft. They can quickly silence the critics by taking care of business as the second-largest Week 1 favorite.

#### __Atlanta Falcons at Pittsburgh Steelers (-2.5, 41.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Steelers -3.5

The Falcons and Steelers will open the season with an inter-conference showdown for the second time in the last three years. Pittsburgh beat Atlanta 18-10 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in 2024 in a game that featured seven field goals and just one touchdown. The Steelers will see a familiar face on the opposite sideline as __Kevin Stefanski__ takes over in Atlanta after a six-year run in Cleveland. Pittsburgh is also starting a new era, with __Mike McCarthy__ taking over for __Mike Tomlin__ after a 19-year run without a losing record. __Tua Tagovailoa__ is likely to open the season as Atlanta’s quarterback, while Pittsburgh continues to await word from __Aaron Rodgers__ for the 2026 season.

#### __New York Jets at Tennessee Titans (-2.5, 38.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Titans -2.5

The Jets will face a prominent former employee to open the season for the second straight year. They dropped a 2-point decision against the __Aaron Rodgers__\-led Steelers last September, and they’ll travel to Nashville to take on their former coach, __Robert Saleh__, and the revamped Titans. Saleh will roll out several former Jets, including __Jermaine Johnson__, __John Franklin-Myers__, and __Solomon Thomas__. The Jets and Titans tied the Raiders and Cardinals for the NFL’s worst record last season, and a victory in the season opener will get one of these teams a third of the way to their win total from 2025. Points will be at a premium in this matchup, as this game features the lowest total on the board.

#### __Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cincinnati Bengals (-3.5, 51.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Bengals -4

Cincinnati’s revamped defense will face an early test against a Buccaneers’ offense that’s going into its first season without __Mike Evans__ for the first time since 2013. The bookmakers don’t believe much has changed for the Bengals' defense, with this game featuring the highest total on the board at 52.5 points. Both teams are trying to return to prominent spots in their respective conferences, and a Week 1 victory could go a long way for one of these teams. The Bengals are looking to end a three-year postseason drought after advancing deep into the playoffs in 2021-22. The Buccaneers are trying to get back to the top of the NFC South after the Panthers ended their four-year run at the top of the division.

#### __Baltimore Ravens (-3.5, 49.5) at Indianapolis Colts__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Ravens -3.5

The Ravens are entering unfamiliar territory as they embark on their first season without __John Harbaugh__ on the sidelines since 2007. Baltimore handed the reins to __Jesse Minter__, who is looking to return the Ravens to the top of the league after they failed to win double-digit games for just the second time in eight years with __Lamar Jackson__ on the roster. The Colts will open the season at home for the fourth straight season. They’re looking to start a Week 1 winning streak after ending an 11-game losing skid in season openers last year. The Colts started with an 8-2 record before losing seven straight contests, thanks in large part to __Daniel Jones__ playing through a hairline fibula fracture before tearing his Achilles early in Week 14. This line would rise to closer to a touchdown if Jones isn’t quite ready to play in the season opener.

#### __Buffalo Bills (-1.5, 44.5) at Houston Texans__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Bills -1

The Bills and Texans both have aspirations of returning to the top of their divisions. Buffalo’s five-year run at the top of the AFC East came to an end at the hands of the Patriots, which eventually resulted in an early exit in the Divisional Round and the firing of __Sean McDermott__. Houston failed to win the AFC South for a third straight year despite winning 12 games. They also exited the playoffs after two postseason games, and those postseason performances created questions about __C.J. Stroud__’s viability as the franchise quarterback moving forward. The Texans scraped out a 23-19 victory as 4.5-point home underdogs with __Davis Mills__ at quarterback in late November.

#### __New Orleans Saints at Detroit Lions (-7.5, 48.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Lions -6

The Saints are an NFC team on the rise this offseason, and the Lions are moving in the opposite direction in the conference. Despite their converging paths, oddsmakers believe the Lions are still a class or two above the Saints entering the season based on the second-largest point spread on the slate. New Orleans surged late in the season under __Tyler Shough__, and the Saints' passing game will test a potentially shaky Detroit secondary, which hopes to have __Brian Branch__ (Achilles) and __Kerby Joseph__ (knee) available for the season opener.

#### __Miami Dolphins at Las Vegas Raiders (-3, 40.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Raiders -3.5

The Raiders landed the big prize in this year’s weak draft class, but __Fernando Mendoza__ could start his career watching from the sidelines if minority owner __Tom Brady__ has as much power as it seems from the outside. __Kirk Cousins__ would see the initial snaps in __Klint Kubiak__’s offense, and __Jeff Hafley__’s defense will look to frustrate the veteran quarterback. Miami will also debut a new quarterback in __Malik Willis__, but he’ll have little to work with at receiver among the likes of __Jalen Tolbert__, __Tutu Atwell__, and __Malik Washington__.

#### __Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Chargers (-9.5, 46.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Chargers -8

This interconference matchup has the least amount of juice on the slate, and it features the largest point spread of the opening week. Arizona will show off its newest toy, __Jeremiyah Love__, whom the Cardinals are hoping can be an immediate difference-maker since he’s making the most guaranteed money ($53.0 million) at the position. The Chargers will debut their new-look offense under __Mike McDaniel__, who brought his motion-heavy, wide-zone rushing attack to Hollywood after a four-year run in South Beach.

#### __Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles (-4.5, 47.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Eagles -6

The __Jayden Daniels__\-led Commanders appeared ready to have yearly marquee matchups against the Eagles after the NFC East foes squared off in the conference title game during his rookie season. Unfortunately, the NFL backloaded its two matchups until the final three weeks of last season, which meant Daniels never faced off against the Eagles. The NFL remedied the situation by having the teams square off in the season opener. Washington wants to announce its back to being a yearly contender in the NFC East in Week 1, while Philadelphia would love to beat a division opponent at home for the second straight year — they defeated the Cowboys in the NFL Kickoff Game in 2025. The Eagles also want to get their offense back on track under new playcaller __Sean Mannion__, and likely without __A.J. Brown__ if he’s traded after June 1.

#### __Green Bay Packers (-1.5, 46.5) at Minnesota Vikings__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Packers -.5

The Packers and Vikings will renew their rivalry in their season opener, and Minnesota will do it with its fourth different starting quarterback to open the year in as many years. The Vikings reached nine wins last season despite a miserable quarterback situation led by the overmatched __J.J. McCarthy__. They brought in __Kyler Murray__ on a cheap deal to try to remedy the situation after the Cardinals ran him out of town. Green Bay hasn’t had issues starting out the season on a good foot, but they’ve faded late in the last two seasons. __Micah Parsons__ and __Tucker Kraft__ are both up in the air for the start of the season following ACL, and this line could draft closer to a pick-em if one or both of them aren’t ready for Week 1. The Packers easily handled the Vikings 23-6 in Lambeau Field in their one meaningful contest last season.

Sunday Night
------------

#### __Dallas Cowboys (-2.5, 46.5) at New York Giants__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Cowboys -.5

After 18 seasons in Baltimore, the __John Harbaugh__ era will begin in New York against an NFC East foe. The Cowboys and Giants will open the season against each other for the 13th time, with Dallas winning 11 of the first 12 matchups. Dallas slaughtered New York 40-0 at MetLife Stadium the last time these teams opened the season on Sunday Night Football in 2023. Dallas won a 40-37 overtime thriller over New York in its lone meaningful game last season — the Cowboys sat key players in their Week 18 matchup — but the Giants covered as 4.5-point underdogs. This line will move closer to a pick-em line if both teams are at full strength, but it could tick toward the Cowboys if __Malik Nabers__ is unable to play early in the season because of his slow ACL recovery.

Monday Night
------------

#### __Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs (-2.5, 43.5)__

\>Brolley’s [Power Ranking](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-power-rankings-post-draft#/) Projection: Chiefs -.5

Does the NFL know something about __Patrick Mahomes__’ availability early in the season? I figured the schedule makers would backload Kansas City’s primetime games and division contests just in case Mahomes was unable to play in the first month of the season. Instead, the Chiefs have one of their most important games on Monday Night Football in the season opener at Arrowhead Stadium. The Broncos made a splashy move to acquire __Jaylen Waddle__, but they’ve otherwise flown under the radar after ending Kansas City’s nine-year run as the NFC West champions. __Bo Nix__ and the Broncos ended Kansas City’s slim hopes of continuing its division title streak with a game-winning, last-second field goal at Mile High in the middle of November, which was the only showdown between the Broncos and the Mahomes-led Chiefs last season. I lean toward taking the points with the Broncos in this early-season showdown against a potentially rusty Mahomes.

-------------------
